# Assets for template tests

These local files are test fixtures only; they are not production assets. The menu content and prices are illustrative, not a real business offer. Screenshots retain the demo label and minimize the existing cart through its own control; the cart is not hidden with CSS.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `photos/salad.jpg` | <https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512621776951-a57141f2eefd?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=85> |
| `photos/plate.jpg` | <https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1547592180-85f173990554?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=85> |
| `photos/pizza.jpg` | <https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1513104890138-7c749659a591?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=85> |
| `fonts/archivo.woff2` | <https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3kPo8UDI-1M0wlSV9XAw6lQkqWY8Q82sLydOxI.woff2> |
| `fonts/material-icons-outlined.woff2` | <https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/materialiconsoutlined/v110/gok-H7zzDkdnRel8-DQ6KAXJ69wP1tGnf4ZGhUce.woff2> |

The fixture hosts the application's existing Archivo text face and Material Icons Outlined locally so the browser test needs no external network. Original font licenses are preserved in `fonts/archivo-OFL.txt` (Google Fonts, `ofl/archivo`) and `fonts/material-icons-LICENSE` (Google Material Design Icons). The template display faces load from the application's `public/fonts/` directory.
